message:
MISSING CDS API CREDENTIALS.
To download ERA5 verification data from ECMWF Copernicus:
  1. Register for an account at https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu
  2. Copy your API key / Personal Access Token from your CDS profile page.
  3. Set environment variable: export CDSAPI_KEY='your_api_key'
     or add `CDSAPI_KEY=your_api_key` to project .env file
     or create ~/.cdsapirc file containing:
        url: https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/api
        key: your_api_key
